bigha.label: pakka bigha (Awadh)

sources.label: UP revenue conversion in common use in the Awadh belt: 1 pakka bigha = 3025 sq yd = 2529.285 sq m

todo: TODO(broker): confirm the bigha size actually used at the Ayodhya sub-registrar. UP has no single bigha: the pakka bigha here is 3025 sq yd, but a kachcha bigha of roughly one third is still quoted in parts of the district. Until confirmed, the bigha column is a labelled convenience only and must not be used for a registry calculation.
